narrative_arc: Personal discovery of a broader platform ecosystem
overall_teaching_goal: Explain that the new capability is embedded inside WhatsApp and Telegram, connect that announcement to the speaker's everyday WhatsApp use and discovery of a larger ecosystem, then create a clear handoff into the upcoming direct demonstration.
key_points: New embedding/integration capability launched inside WhatsApp and Telegram
Transition from everyday single-app use to discovering a wider connected ecosystem
Forward-looking expectation of improved workflow and capabilities
Direct transition and lead-in to a live demonstration

host_strategy.default: Keep the host full-frame and primary as the relationship anchor for personal statements and the demo handoff.
host_strategy.evidence_rule: When platform relationship and ecosystem diagrams carry the explanation (Beats 1-2), smoothly shrink the host once over 0.4s into a lower-corner chip opposite the face safe area. Hold the host in this continuous chip state across Beats 1 and 2, then restore full-frame at the start of Beat 3.
host_strategy.caption_rule: Retain accepted P6 source captions exactly as rendered: no timing, wording, or styling changes. Visual layers and cards must remain strictly outside the caption safe zone.

asset_policy.allowed: Official WhatsApp and Telegram brand badges/icons, neutral integration glyphs, and real product demo frames if supplied in the next segment.
asset_policy.prohibited: Mock chat screens, fake user interfaces, fabricated data, or decorative noise unrelated to the spoken explanation.

beats.message: أطلقت ميزة هي تضمين داخل واتساب وتيليجرام.
beats.why_visual_needed: Shows the concrete integration architecture connecting the new capability to the two named platforms (WhatsApp & Telegram) so viewers immediately grasp where the feature lives.
beats.host_layout: Full-frame host initially (12.82s - 14.68s); on 'تضمين' (14.68s) smoothly shrink host over 0.4s into a bottom-right chip and hold there through Beat 2.
recipe_or_component: Karve P6 callout card (title: 'ميزة تضمين داخل واتساب وتيليجرام')
custom: PlatformIntegrationDiagram (WhatsApp badge + Telegram badge linked via central embedding core)
beats.timing_anchor: 14.68s (word 'تضمين') triggers the host shrink and relationship diagram reveal; settle by 16.36s and hold.
required_asset_or_evidence: Neutral integration link line / connector glyph

beats.message: أنا بستخدم واتساب بشكل مستمر ولكن اكتشفت انه هو عالم كتير كبير وبدأت باستخدامه.
beats.why_visual_needed: Visually expands the single WhatsApp platform node into a broader connected ecosystem network, illustrating the speaker's realization that the tool spans beyond basic messaging.
beats.host_layout: Maintain continuous bottom-right host chip established in Beat 1 (zero layout churn); host remains visible while the central diagram transforms.
recipe_or_component: custom: EcosystemExpansionDiagram (continuous transformation of Beat 1's diagram: WhatsApp node zooms/expands to reveal surrounding interconnected ecosystem nodes)
video-talkcraft: slow-pull-reveal (for the surrounding ecosystem nodes)
beats.timing_anchor: 22.04s (words 'ولكن اكتشفت') triggers the expansion of surrounding ecosystem nodes; completes by 24.30s ('عالم كتير كبير').
required_asset_or_evidence: 3 neutral ecosystem node glyphs with connector vectors (تكاملات، إمكانيات أوسع، تطبيقات متصلة)

beats.message: وهلأ مع بتوقع انه لح يصير لسه الموضوع أفضل وأفضل.
beats.why_visual_needed: Reinforces the speaker's forward-looking optimism and value proposition without introducing speculative roadmap claims.
beats.host_layout: Restore host smoothly to full-frame at 24.96s as ecosystem diagram fades out; host is primary anchor throughout the beat.
recipe_or_component: Karve P6 native caption emphasis (preserves accepted P6 caption styling; no external keyword pop on caption)
custom: ValueAccentIndicator (independent subtle upward trend / enhancement badge positioned above face/caption safe zone)
beats.timing_anchor: 28.12s (word 'لح يصير') triggers native caption emphasis; accent indicator holds from 28.64s to 29.50s.

beats.why_visual_needed: Creates a clear directional handoff and anticipation from narrative explanation into the upcoming live demonstration.
beats.host_layout: Host remains full-frame and primary. Directional cue overlays cleanly without layout disruption.
recipe_or_component: custom: DirectionalHandoffCue (subtle directional chevron / action arrow indicating upcoming demo)
video-talkcraft: caret-wipe-transition (CONDITIONAL: applied only if a real verified next-demo surface asset is supplied; otherwise falls back to DirectionalHandoffCue alone)
beats.timing_anchor: 30.60s (word 'نشوف') reveals directional handoff cue; settles by 31.28s ('مباشرة') and holds through 31.92s.
required_asset_or_evidence: Real next-demo screen capture (conditional; do not fabricate if absent)
